justification: Changes the brief every AI read of a council DCP uses, what the word-for-word checker accepts, and adds a production write (council_quote --apply) after every publish. Wrong, the reader could cut a condition from its list, or a rule could be marked as the council's words when it is not.

pre_impl.existing_data: regulatory_provisions quote columns (migration 111/112); dcp_review_queue AI reads; dcp_chapter_registry active PDF
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The model's page counts from the chunk it was sent, not the document: converted with first + page - 1 and used only when the words cannot place the rule
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Brief applies to new reads only; the checker change re-judges on its next run; the publish hook writes only the chapters it just committed
pre_impl.external_source_error: A PDF that cannot be read keeps its stored verdict (pdf_unreadable is never written); a failed copier run is printed with its re-run command and never undoes the publish
pre_impl.frontend_type: No frontend change: the site already reads quote_status and council_quote, which this only fills for new rules
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: If the copier does not run, new rules show 'Not yet checked against the council's PDF' -- visible, not silent

functions.name: run_council_quote
functions.input: the council slug and the chapter_key that this publish run just committed to production
functions.output: exit code of council_quote.py --apply for that chapter
functions.if_none: exception or non-zero exit printed as [warn] with the re-run command

functions.name: _model_page
functions.input: the model's chunk-relative page, chunk first and last page
functions.output: the document page number inside the chunk the model was sent, or None when outside or unreadable
functions.if_none: rule keeps the chunk's first page; dcp_page_repair re-checks it after publish

values.if_missing: served rows carry no code: the figure-code rule does not apply and the rule is judged as before

queries.purpose: served rules of one chapter for the copier
queries.where_clause: is_current AND v2_is_actionable AND source_council IS NOT NULL AND active chapter PDF; council = %s; chapter filtered in Python
queries.if_wrong: the writer only updates rows whose text md5 and active PDF still match the judged ones

break_it.scenario: A superscript makes a different number match ('243' vs '24m2')
break_it.what_happens: a wrong number would be proven as the council's own and shown as its words
break_it.how: superscripts map to their digit only; '243' still differs from '24m2'

break_it.scenario: A real rule inside a figure is dropped as labels
break_it.what_happens: a rule would disappear from the confirmed set
break_it.how: figure_labels only when the code names a figure AND the text has no rule wording

break_it.scenario: The model's page overrides where the words are printed
break_it.what_happens: a rule links a page that does not hold it
break_it.how: the locator decides; the model page only fills a gap and only inside the chunk

break_it.scenario: The copier fails after publish and the run reports success
break_it.what_happens: new rules would silently show as not yet checked while the log reads as success
break_it.how: run_council_quote prints [warn] with the re-run command on non-zero exit or exception

break_it.scenario: The copier judges every chapter of the council instead of the one committed
break_it.what_happens: a publish would rewrite quotes for chapters nobody touched, costing time and hiding which run wrote them
break_it.how: run_council_quote passes --council and --chapter; council_quote_db.fetch filters on source_chapter_key

falsifiable_check.fails_when: the brief loses word-for-word / lead-in / page wording, the checker drops the superscript map or figure-label rule, or the publish step stops calling the copier per chapter
falsifiable_check.observed_red: The figure-label test failed red during development (a stray control character in the regex) before it passed.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: Pilot 2026-10-12 (plan AI BRIEF PILOT): CoS 81% -> 96% exact with v2; Hornsby 89% -> 97% excluding picture text after the two checker fixes.

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes: the next publish log prints 'council words for <council>/<chapter>: stored: N of N'
